feeds.title: Angry Metal Guy » Symphonic Metal
feeds.description: Browse our blog for posts on symphonic metal music reviews. AMG is the standard by which all should be judged, which is why they started this music blog page. On their blog, they post Metal Reviews, Interviews, and General Angryness.

feeds.title: Tuonela Magazine » Symphonic Metal
feeds.description: In their Symphonic Metal section, they talk about new releases, album reviews, tours, concerts, the latest news, and updates. Tuonela Magazine was founded in February 2017, with the idea of promoting both young and established Finnish bands, as well as internationally renowned and promising artists who are involved with the scene worldwide. They mostly focus on metal, rock, independent, and alternative music, but don't necessarily limit themselves to one genre.

feeds.title: Wonderbox Metal » Symphonic Metal
feeds.description: In their Symphonic Metal blog, they publish articles on reviews, the latest releases, and updates. Aiming to promote the best that metal music has to offer. Wonderbox Metal is based in the UK. They specialize in metal album reviews, along with the occasional interview, premier, list, etc.

feeds.title: Metal Rules » Symphonic Metal
feeds.description: They have a section dedicated to Symphonic metal music where they share the latest releases, music reviews, band reviews, artist interviews, and updates regarding these same. Metal Rules have been promoting real Metal Online Since 1995.

feeds.title: Markus Heavy Music Blog » Symphonic Metal
feeds.description: The blog section of Symphonic metal covers all the latest news, updates, album reviews, and new releases. Markus' Heavy Music Blog is a 100% non-commercial blog and everything that's posted on the blog is purely based on my own passion for rock and metal music.

feeds.title: Xiphea Blog
feeds.description: The idea for Fairymetal Night came up in the spring of 2017. Originally, it was supposed to be a concert evening under the motto of fairy tales and metal. In their blog, they share the latest news, updates, new music, videos, podcast, and more.

feeds.title: Folk N Rock » Symphonic Metal
feeds.description: Folk N Rock is the link between fusions styles of music and their parent genres. Our coverage includes your garden variety of Folk, Hard Rock, Roots, Punk, Metal, and more, with a special focus on the artist that infuses various styles. Some of those include Celtic Punk, Folk Metal, Folk Rock, Symphonic, Medieval, and an endless list of other combinations. Their blog includes Symphonic metal, where they post information about the latest happening in the industry, new albums & single releases, interviews.

feeds.title: My Global Mind » Symphonic Metal
feeds.description: Explore articles, and reviews on the symphonic metal genre. Welcome to Myglobalmind Magazine. They are one of the premier online magazines in the genres of Hard Rock and Heavy Metal and have been around since our humble beginnings in 2007 and have risen from the ashes of past great online magazines. The magazine covers Symphonic Metal topics and publishes articles on new songs, reviews, the latest news, and updates.
